findings.issue: Dual construct of the rear/extreme parts is smoothed to a bare plural; Spanish has no dual, and fondos stays inside that range (rear/recess) without counting dos.
The sea noun is absolute; el is Spanish article smoothing. The directional suffix is still only toward the sea.

notes: Y, a, tabernáculo, hacia, harás, seis, and tablas match the conjunction, preposition, definite tabernacle, directional sea, qal imperfect 2ms, six, and plural boards.
